sources.title: GitHub - GuglielmoCerri/pytorch-dino-ai-game: Repository for training ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains code and resources for creating an AI model that can play the popular Chrome Dino Game using PyTorch and EfficientNet. The goal of this project is to train an AI agent to achieve high scores in the game by automatically detecting and reacting to obstacles. The repository includes scripts for capturing game screens, processing the captured images to create a dataset ...

sources.title: DINO (computer vision) - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: DINO (self- DI stillation with NO labels) is a family of self-supervised learning methods for computer vision from Meta AI that trains Vision Transformers (ViTs) on unlabeled images and produces general-purpose visual features rivaling or surpassing those learned with human-labeled supervision [1] [2].

sources.title: Dino AI — An AI that learns to play on its own
sources.snippet: Dino AI: an artificial intelligence that learns, entirely on its own, to play Chrome's dinosaur game. It watches the screen, detects obstacles, and learns through reinforcement (PPO) when to jump.

sources.title: GitHub - JakkNaj/laya-dino: Local LAYA learns to run, jump and duck in ...
sources.snippet: A local AI experiment: teach LAYA when to RUN, JUMP and DUCK in the original T-Rex game. TypeScript frontend, Python backend, official LAYA SDK. Every live action comes from the model; no heuristic overrides and no learning between runs.
